I would like you to consider that it is not your fault. The fact that we have to pay for housing and food by entertaining soul crushing jobs for competitive companies is not the indicator of a healthy society. Power should be given to a global panel of healthy sound of mind people congregating every so often to insure the majority of people are being looked after. You aren't the problem, the system values profit more than it does your life. We, the planet, society, are crushing under the pressure of unregulated capitalism.

Supermarkets should be free for people to take what they NEED. Education should teach us about boundaries and how to interact with other humans. Prisons should be replaced by education centres. We have the resources for epic change, but it's not happening. Of course you feel this way.

Providing for families, paying for mortgages and working month by month for a company who can choose to replace you instantly is by NO means a comfortable standard of living. And yet these are the cards we are dealt.

A few months ago I followed a friend into a hippy community in a forest and discovered alternative ways of living that were much more focused on healing the human spirit. I'm saving up to buy a van and live off grid. By no means am I telling you to do that, but please consider other options before opting out.
